newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX January natgas hits contract high of $3.83.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX January natgas hits contract high of $3.83.

text.p: NYMEX natural gas futures for January delivery at Henry Hub, La., set a new contract high of $3.83 per million British thermal units (mmBtu) late in Friday's session.
The contract, which expires December 24, rose 30.1 cents from Thursday's settlement, replacing the previous high of $3.80.
Traders attributed the rally to forecasts for significantly colder temperatures across most of the U.S., excluding the East Coast, by Tuesday.
In the cash market, Gulf prices were talked nearly 20 cents higher in the mid-to-high $3.50s.
At 1411 EST, January natgas futures continued their move higher, hitting $3.86 per mmBtu, up 33.1 cents from the previous close.
